expo.name: SAAR
expo._comment_userInterfaceStyle: automatic, not light — the app has a real dark theme (Ch. 11.7) driven by useColorScheme, and 'light' would pin every device to the light palette.

android._comment_package: Must match the Android package name registered in Firebase EXACTLY. A mismatch produces a build that installs and then silently receives no push.
android._comment_googleServicesFile: Firebase project saar-8a829. expo-notifications reads this at prebuild and injects the google-services Gradle plugin itself — the Gradle snippets the Firebase console shows must NOT be applied by hand, because android/ is generated and regenerated on every build.

expo._comment_extra: eas.projectId is what getExpoPushTokenAsync reads (src/state/DeviceContext.tsx). Without it the call throws and no device ever registers a token. This is the id from the Expo dashboard; `eas init --id` writes the same value.
